Prosecution gets probe report on 2 Kishoreganj ‘Razakars’
2014-11-26T14:38:20+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/prosecution-gets-probe-report-on-2-kishoreganj-razakars-52160

An investigation agency of the international crimes tribunal today submitted to the prosecution the probe report against two alleged war criminals of Kishoreganj.

The suspected war criminals are: Nasir Uddin Ahmed, 62, a former army officer; and his brother Shamsuddin Ahmed, 60, a member of Kishoreganj Bar Association.

Investigator Ataur Rahman submitted the report to Prosecutor Syed Haidar Ali around 10:45am.

The investigation agency, designated to deal with war crimes probes, brought five charges against the two siblings for allegedly committing the crimes against humanity during the country’s Liberation War in 1971.

The investigation against the duo began in June last year.
